answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gyorin Formation for 2 energy. It gave 10 Block immediately and set up 6 Block at the start of my next turn, which fully covers the telegraphed 8 damage from Sludge Spinner.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Sounding Line followed by Coral Guard. That line would deal 12 damage, apply Hydro, spend 6 Charge, and gain 5 Block, but it would leave me taking 3 damage this turn and would forgo the extra 6 Block next turn.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up all immediate damage, all Hydro application this turn, and the chance to spend 6 Charge. It also left Sludge Spinner at full 34 HP instead of reducing it, trading pressure for stronger current and next-turn defense.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy had telegraphed a non-attack, a very weak attack, or an effect that made immediate pressure more valuable than defense, I would have been more inclined to play Sounding Line with Coral Guard or Water's Edge to deal damage and spend Charge. Against the printed 8 Attack, Gyorin Formation was the clearer choice.
